title: homerun2-notification-catcher-notify chart
_comment: additionalProperties left open so the catalog verifier (call-argocd-verify-catalog) can inject its common probe values like `destination` without tripping the schema. The chart only consumes `name` and `content`; anything else is ignored.

name.description: ConfigMap name. Must match notificationCatcher.notifyConfigMap in apps/homerun2/install, which the Deployment patch mounts.

content.description: The notify config (config.yaml) as a YAML string: outputs and their filters. `${TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL}` placeholders are passed through verbatim for the catcher to expand.
